description: Subtle, straight embankment running NW–SE, approximately 2–3 m wide and ~140 m long. Visible in the DTM hillshade as a low‐relief linear ridge with paired shallow flanking troughs. The feature has no correspondence on the modern OpenStreetMap layer and is repeated faintly as a darker line in the NIR composite.

Right‐angle corner of two embankments forming an L‐shaped enclosure, each arm measuring ~80 m. The convex embankments stand ~0.3 m above surrounding terrain in the DTM and align with slight NIR vegetation stress (darker tone) along their axes.

N–S trending moisture‐dark line in the NIR band, ~4 m wide and ~120 m long, co‐located with a subtle linear depression in the terrain curvature map. Likely a buried drainage canal or water‐collection ditch with anthropogenic soil signature (“dark earth”) promoting higher moisture retention.
